warning.title: SECURE PERSISTENCE CONTRACT
warning.text: Upon activation, HVE will deploy a guardian shield and inject a secure path into your hyprland.conf. If you uninstall the plugin from the Shell, the system will self-clean on the next reboot without causing Hyprland errors.

home.about_short: Hyprland Visual Editor makes your desktop truly yours.
home.about_full:
HVE customizes Hyprland animations, borders, and shaders from a visual interface, in real time.

To apply changes, HVE adds a block at the end of your hyprland.lua (or hyprland.conf), delimited by markers. That block only includes (dofile / source) our overlay files in ~/.cache/hve/ — it never rewrites your personal config.

When you disable the system, the markers are removed. If you uninstall, a watchdog cleans them on the next Hyprland start. Your original config always stays intact.
home.about_line_1: Live preview — tweak and see it instantly
home.about_line_2: Safe assembly — zero risk to your configs
home.about_line_3: Hot reload — apply without restarting Hyprland
home.about_line_4: Fragments — composable pieces, not one huge file
